examples.source: The teacher nudged students to check their answers.
examples.target: 老師促使學生檢查答案。

examples.source: The message nudged him to start revising.
examples.target: 訊息提醒他開始溫習。

nugget.meaning: 小段有用資訊 / 小塊珍貴資料

examples.source: The teacher shared a useful grammar nugget.
examples.target: 老師分享了一小段有用文法知識。

examples.source: The interview included a nugget of career advice.
examples.target: 訪問包含一小段有用的職業建議。

examples.source: I found a golden nugget of information in the report.
examples.target: 我在報告中找到一小塊珍貴資料。

new kid on the block.meaning: 新加入者 / 新興競爭者

examples.source: The small company is the new kid on the block.
examples.target: 這間小公司是新興競爭者。

examples.source: As the new kid on the block, she listened carefully.
examples.target: 作為新加入者，她仔細聆聽。

examples.source: The app is the new kid on the block in education.
examples.target: 這個應用程式是教育界的新興競爭者。

examples.source: There was next to no traffic this morning.
examples.target: 今早幾乎沒有交通擠塞。

examples.source: The project had next to no support at first.
examples.target: 項目起初幾乎沒有支持。

examples.source: He finished the task with next to no help.
examples.target: 他幾乎沒有得到幫助就完成任務。

nip at one's heels.meaning: 輕咬腳跟 / 緊追不放

examples.source: A younger runner was nipping at his heels.
examples.target: 一名較年輕的跑手緊追著他。

examples.source: Small brands are nipping at the company's heels.
examples.target: 小品牌正緊追這間公司。

examples.source: The dog kept nipping at his heels.
examples.target: 那隻狗一直輕咬他的腳跟。

no merit to.meaning: 沒有道理 / 沒有價值

examples.source: There is no merit to that complaint.
examples.target: 那個投訴沒有道理。

examples.source: The judge said there was no merit to the claim.
examples.target: 法官指該說法沒有根據。

examples.source: There is no merit to copying homework.
examples.target: 抄功課沒有任何價值。

examples.source: She is no stranger to hard work.
examples.target: 她對辛勤工作並不陌生。

examples.source: Hong Kong is no stranger to heavy rain.
examples.target: 香港對大雨並不陌生。

examples.source: The writer is no stranger to criticism.
examples.target: 這位作家熟悉批評。

no walk in the park.meaning: 並非易事 / 不是輕鬆的事

examples.source: Preparing for the exam is no walk in the park.
examples.target: 準備考試並非易事。

examples.source: Running a small business is no walk in the park.
examples.target: 經營小生意不是輕鬆的事。

examples.source: The hike was beautiful but no walk in the park.
examples.target: 遠足很美，但並非易事。

examples.source: The sequel is not a patch on the first film.
examples.target: 續集遠不及第一集電影。

examples.source: This copy is not a patch on the original.
examples.target: 這個複製版本比不上原作。

examples.source: My drawing is not a patch on hers.
examples.target: 我的畫遠不及她的畫。

not get someone anywhere.meaning: 沒有進展 / 沒有結果

examples.source: Complaining will not get you anywhere.
examples.target: 只懂投訴不會有任何進展。

examples.source: This argument is not getting us anywhere.
examples.target: 這場爭論沒有令我們有任何結果。

examples.source: Guessing blindly will not get students anywhere.
examples.target: 盲目亂猜不會令學生有進展。

not in my back yard.meaning: 鄰避心態 / 不要在我家附近

examples.source: The protest showed a Not In My Back Yard attitude.
examples.target: 這次抗議顯示出鄰避心態。

examples.source: The article discusses Not In My Back Yard thinking.
examples.target: 文章討論鄰避心態。

examples.source: Some residents supported the shelter, but said Not In My Back Yard.
examples.target: 有些居民支持庇護中心，但說不要建在我家附近。

not in the know.meaning: 不知情的 / 不了解內情的

examples.source: Most students were not in the know about the change.
examples.target: 大部分學生對這個改變並不知情。

examples.source: People not in the know may misunderstand the joke.
examples.target: 不了解內情的人可能會誤解這個笑話。

examples.source: I was not in the know, so I asked for details.
examples.target: 我不知情，所以問清楚細節。

examples.source: This small café is not in the same league as that famous restaurant.
examples.target: 這間小咖啡店不能與那間名店相比。

examples.source: My old phone is not in the same league as yours.
examples.target: 我的舊電話不及你的電話。

examples.source: The first draft is not in the same league as the final version.
examples.target: 初稿不能與終稿相比。

not know the first thing about.meaning: 對...一竅不通 / 完全不了解

examples.source: I do not know the first thing about coding.
examples.target: 我對編程一竅不通。

examples.source: He does not know the first thing about cooking.
examples.target: 他對煮食完全不了解。

examples.source: Do not pretend if you do not know the first thing about it.
examples.target: 如果你對它一竅不通，就不要假裝懂。

not sold on.meaning: 未完全信服 / 不太相信

examples.source: I am not sold on the idea yet.
examples.target: 我仍未完全信服這個想法。

examples.source: The teacher was not sold on our first plan.
examples.target: 老師不太相信我們第一個計劃可行。

examples.source: Some users are not sold on the new design.
examples.target: 有些用戶未完全信服新設計。

not to be sneezed at.meaning: 不容小覷的 / 相當可觀的

examples.source: A ten-percent increase is not to be sneezed at.
examples.target: 百分之十的增幅不容小覷。

examples.source: The prize money is not to be sneezed at.
examples.target: 獎金相當可觀。

examples.source: Her improvement is not to be sneezed at.
examples.target: 她的進步不容小覷。

not to say.meaning: 但這不代表 / 並不是說

examples.source: The task is difficult, not to say impossible.
examples.target: 任務很困難，甚至可以說近乎不可能。

examples.source: He was tired, not to say exhausted.
examples.target: 他很累，甚至可以說筋疲力盡。

examples.source: The room was small, not to say uncomfortable.
examples.target: 房間很小，甚至可以說不舒服。

examples.source: She played the song note for note.
examples.target: 她一個音符不差地彈奏那首歌。

examples.source: The student copied the melody note for note.
examples.target: 學生一個音符不差地複製旋律。

examples.source: The band performed the classic song note for note.
examples.target: 樂隊一個音符不差地演奏經典歌曲。

nothing in it.meaning: 沒有甚麼了不起 / 沒甚麼特別

examples.source: The rumour sounded serious, but there was nothing in it.
examples.target: 謠言聽起來嚴重，但其實沒甚麼特別。

examples.source: People worried about the complaint, but there was nothing in it.
examples.target: 大家擔心投訴，但其實沒有甚麼了不起。

examples.source: The coach said there was nothing in it after the small argument.
examples.target: 小爭執後，教練說沒甚麼大不了。

examples.source: The novelty wears off after a few days.
examples.target: 幾日後新鮮感就會消退。

examples.source: When the novelty wore off, students used the app less.
examples.target: 新鮮感消退後，學生較少使用應用程式。

examples.source: Good design matters after the novelty wears off.
examples.target: 新鮮感消退後，好設計就很重要。
